issue.title: Ipv6 e-BGP default route not getting programmed if ipv6 management config is not done on eth0

failure.body:
What is the Issue:

If there no ipv6 management config on eth0 we have accept_ra flag enable on eth0 which cause default route to be learned over link-local via RA message. Since this route is added by Kernel with metric 1024 which has higher priority of e-BGP learn default route the e-BGP default route is not porgammed and cause dataplane impact.

resolution.title: Assign the higher metric value for Ipv6 default route learnt via RA message
resolution.description:
What I did:
Assign the metric value for Ipv6 default route learnt via RA message to
higher value so that BGP learnt default route is higher priority.

This change depend on this Kernel Patch: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-linux-kernel/pull/326

ADO: 24888962

Why I did:
Fixes : https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/16209

How I verify:
Manual Verification to make sure after setting metric e-BGP learnt default is always higher priority over RA default route.
